landing.headline: From planning to the ring, boxing training in one place.
landing.subtitle: Coaches build each class in minutes and follow every fighter's progress. Students check in, see today's class and their own stats.
landing.heroAlt: Class planning: the class blocks and one column for each student who checked in

board.title: Class planning
board.text: Drag exercises onto one student, a pair, a group or everyone, block by block.

calendar.title: Calendar and cycles
calendar.text: Regular classes, sparring, extra and cancelled classes, organized in macro, meso and microcycles.

profile.title: Fighter profile
profile.text: Level, main and secondary style, strengths, technical adjustments, focuses and notes.

stats.title: Student stats
stats.text: A score for each skill, with a guide that goes from beginner to competition level.

attendance.title: Attendance and ranking
attendance.text: Check-ins, absences closed automatically every Sunday, and an attendance ranking.

checkin.title: Check in
checkin.text: Let the coach know you're coming and whether you have any pain or injury.

today.title: Today's class
today.text: See the published class, the week's objective and the focuses your coach wrote for you.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.text: Follow your stats, your fighting style and your place in the ranking.

landing.showcaseProfileAlt: Student profile with main and secondary style
landing.showcaseStatsAlt: Student stats table with the rating guide
landing.finalText: Log in with the username and password your coach gave you.

blockMode.COLLECTIVE: Group block: drag the exercise onto "Everyone". Everyone does it together at a fixed time.
blockMode.INDIVIDUAL: Individual block: each student starts as soon as they finish the general warm-up. Drag an exercise onto each student.
blockMode.PAIRS: Pairs block: drop the exercise on a student and drag the partner onto the card.

settings.title: Settings
settings.scheduleHint: Weekdays with classes and the time of each one. Regular classes are created automatically; future classes that are still empty move to the new time.
settings.categoriesHint: Use them to organize the library (warm-up, technique, conditioning…).
settings.gymHint: The gym's name and the color of the student area. The coach area stays red.
settings.gymError: Couldn't save. Check the name and color.
settings.valencesHint: Physical capacities each mesocycle works on (speed, strength…).
settings.phasesHint: Kinds of week within a mesocycle (adaptation, shock…). A new mesocycle starts with one week of each phase.
settings.duplicateName: An item with this name already exists.
settings.blocksHint: The parts of every class, in order. Group blocks can have a fixed time (minutes after the class starts).
settings.metricsHint: The stats you score for each student, split into physical capacities and technical skills.
settings.checkinDeadlineHint: After this deadline, students can no longer check in or cancel.
settings.fighterClassesHint: Fighting styles you assign to each student. Click a class to edit it.
settings.assessmentScaleHint: The range of each stat's score. The default is 1 to 10.
settings.classImageHint: The uploaded image replaces the chosen artwork. JPG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB; a transparent PNG looks best.
settings.confirmArchiveClass: Delete the class {{name}}? Students with this class will have none.
settings.scaleInvalid: The maximum score must be higher than the minimum.

calendar.hint: Click a day: open the class, turn it into sparring or create an extra class.
